text: Every residential building must comply with National Building Code (NBC) India structural safety guidelines.
Minimum habitable room height should be 2.7 meters as per Indian building standards.
Every habitable room must have natural light and ventilation through windows or openings.
Fire exits must be clearly accessible and unobstructed in all multi-storey buildings.
Staircase minimum width in residential buildings should be 0.9 meters.
Handrails are mandatory for staircases above three steps for safety compliance.
Electrical wiring must follow IS 732 safety standards for domestic installations.
Bathrooms must have proper waterproofing and drainage slope to prevent water stagnation.
Building foundation depth must be based on soil type and load-bearing capacity.
Fire-resistant materials must be used in high-rise structural elements as per NBC guidelines.
